newsitem.title: UK: Plane Handling secures Heathrow's Cargo Point site.
newsitem.headline: Plane Handling secures Heathrow's Cargo Point site.

text.p: Plane Handling said it has acquired the 6.4 acres Cargo Point site at Heathrow that will give it 13,000 sq m of warehouse space next door to Heathrow airpoprt.
The 140,000 sq foot warehouse is directly opposite Cargo Village at Heathrow and will replace one of four existing Plane Handling facilities at Heathrow.
It will include a fully bonded Customs handling area and temporary storage facilities.

Plane Handling, owned by handlers GHI and Virgin Atlantic Services, said that work on the 20 million stg ($33.4 million) project has already started and is due for completion by the end of this year. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com ($ = 0.599 British Pounds)
